title: 🧭 Simple Mode + Cleaner Trades
notes: 🧭 New Simple layout: bigger text, bigger buttons, and just three tabs (Standings, Rosters, Trades). Tap the W at the top to pick Classic, Compact or Simple.
🤝 In Simple, making a trade is step by step: pick a team, tap what you want, tap what you'll give, then see in plain words whether it's fair before you send it.
📋 The Trade Block is now one small bar on the Trades tab. Tap it to see who's on the block.
↔️ The trade builder now says "You give" and "You get", draft picks are tap-to-pick buttons, and Send stays at the bottom of the screen while you build.
🔍 The trade meter shows the verdict up front; fit, sources and the math are under "More detail".
📬 Pending trades now sit near the top of the Trades tab so offers waiting on you are easy to find.
